correctness.rationale: The exhibited twelve-element admissible multiset has only homogeneous six-subsets summing to multiples of six, and each homogeneous sum is 36. The exact descending subset-sum recurrence modulo 36 visits all sorted bad prefixes by induction and sound hereditary pruning, emitting 23,970 bad twelve-multisets. Each is checked against all 30 possible extensions via its five-subset sums. A separate checker uses direct index combinations to test all six-subsets and all possible extensions and enumerates every affine orbit and profile directly. Both complete programs were executed on the attached data, and no sampled-to-infinite inference occurs.

value.rationale: The result completes the first squarefree composite instance of a 2026 rank-one exact-divisibility zero-sum conjecture and determines all maximal obstruction configurations, including eleven class-count profiles and a complete 361-orbit symmetry spectrum. The inverse-data classification is structurally useful as a sharp composite-modulus benchmark and is not implied by the existing general 13–21 bound or prime/prime-power cases; no assertion for larger n is made.
